# AI Engineer Interview Questions (Valenx Press)

> A free, answer-first AI engineer interview question bank covering LLM fundamentals, RAG, agents, evaluation, system design and production, with free browser tools (answer self-check, study plan, LLM API cost calculator, mock round timer) and preparation guides.

Content is educational interview preparation, not a record of questions asked by specific employers. Company guides cite only official public careers pages and describe interview stages as a general industry pattern. Rubrics are practice aids, not hiring standards.

## Question bank

- [AI engineer interview questions with answers](https://aie.valenx.org/): the full question bank on one page
- [Question deep dives](https://aie.valenx.org/questions/): one page per question with framework, sample answer and follow-ups
- [Chinese mirror (first 20 questions)](https://aie.valenx.org/zh/)

## Free tools

- [Answer self-check](https://aie.valenx.org/answer-check/): score a practiced answer against a rubric in the browser
- [Study plan](https://aie.valenx.org/study-plan/): day-by-day plan from today to the interview date
- [LLM API cost calculator](https://aie.valenx.org/llm-cost-calculator/): cost per request, day and month from official list prices
- [Mock interview round](https://aie.valenx.org/mock-interview/): timed practice round

## Comparisons

- [AI engineer interview prep alternatives](https://aie.valenx.org/alternatives/): ByteByteGo, Educative, Gumroad guides and free options by price and format
- [Exponent (Now Aced) Alternatives for AI Engineer Interviews (2026)](https://aie.valenx.org/alternatives/exponent-alternatives/): Exponent (now Aced) vs Hello Interview, ByteByteGo, Educative and free options for AI engineer interview prep: prices checked Nov 2, 2026.
- [Hello Interview Alternatives for AI Engineer Interviews (2026)](https://aie.valenx.org/alternatives/hello-interview-alternatives/): Hello Interview alternatives for AI engineer interviews: Aced (Exponent), ByteByteGo, Educative and free options by price and format, Nov 2, 2026.
- [Interview Query Alternatives for ML and AI Engineer Interviews (2026)](https://aie.valenx.org/alternatives/interview-query-alternatives/): Interview Query vs StrataScratch, DataLemur, LeetML, Hello Interview and free AI engineer prep: prices checked Nov 2, 2026, and which fits an ML or AI loop.

## Preparation guides

- [How to Prepare for an AI Engineer Interview in 2026](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/how-to-prepare-for-an-ai-engineer-interview-2026/): Prepare for an AI engineer interview in 2026: Python coding, LLM and RAG fundamentals, evaluation and system design, with a practice checklist and FAQ.
- [AI Engineer vs ML Engineer Interview: What Is Different?](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/ai-engineer-vs-ml-engineer-interview/): AI engineer vs ML engineer interviews: which topics get deeper questions, how system design and coding differ, and how to split your prep.
- [RAG System Design Interview: A Scoring Rubric](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/rag-system-design-interview-scoring-rubric/): A transparent 100-point practice rubric for RAG system design interviews: requirements, ingestion, retrieval, grounding, evaluation and production.
- [LLM Evaluation Interview Questions and How to Answer Them](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/llm-evaluation-interview-questions/): LLM evaluation interview questions with answers: datasets, RAG and hallucination checks, metrics, LLM judges, safety and release decisions.
- [A 2-Week AI Engineer Interview Study Plan](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/two-week-ai-engineer-interview-study-plan/): A 14-day AI engineer interview study plan: daily coding, LLM fundamentals, a small RAG build, evaluation and timed mock practice.
- [RAG Interview Questions and Answers (2026): 24 Questions from Basics to Production](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/rag-interview-questions/): 24 RAG interview questions with model answers: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, permissions and debugging, plus a 5-step framework.
- [AI Agent Interview Questions and Answers (2026): 22 Agentic AI Questions](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/ai-agent-interview-questions/): 22 AI agent interview questions with model answers: agent loops, tool calling, MCP, memory, multi-agent design, evaluation and guardrails.
- [AI System Design Interview Questions (2026): 15 LLM Design Prompts with Answer Outlines](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/ai-system-design-interview-questions/): 15 AI and LLM system design interview prompts with answer outlines, a 45-minute round structure and a self-scoring checklist for 2026.
- [LLM Interview Questions and Answers (2026): 25 Questions from Basics to Production](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/llm-interview-questions/): 25 LLM interview questions with model answers: transformers, tokens, decoding, LoRA, RLHF, quantization, hallucination and serving, plus a level table and FAQ.
- [Prompt Engineering Interview Questions and Answers (2026)](https://aie.valenx.org/guides/prompt-engineering-interview-questions/): 22 prompt engineering interview questions with model answers: few-shot, chain of thought, JSON output, prompt injection, evaluation and versioning, plus FAQ.

## Machine interface (read-only)

- [questions.json](https://aie.valenx.org/api/questions.json): static JSON catalog of question deep-dives (id, title, level, answer summary, canonical URL)
- [API index](https://aie.valenx.org/api/): human-readable pointer page
- [mcp.json](https://aie.valenx.org/mcp.json): MCP/server descriptor (descriptor-only; no hosted MCP HTTP endpoint)
